text: {"memo": "As of March 31, 2025, Intel’s most recently completed fiscal year was fiscal 2024, ended December 28, 2024. Revenue was $53.1 billion, down about 1% from $54.2 billion in fiscal 2023. Net income was about $9.0 billion, or $1.72 per share, versus $9.8 billion, or $1.97 per share, in fiscal 2023. Operating income was roughly $13.8 billion, and operating margin about 26%, down from around 29% in fiscal 2023. Cash flow from operations was strong, around $31 billion, with free cash flow perhaps $28 billion. In fiscal 2022, revenue was $63.1 billion, net income was about $1.0 billion, and operating margin was about 13%, reflecting a difficult year. Fiscal 2021 revenue was $79.0 billion, net income $18.4 billion, and EPS $3.56, a period of strong growth. The recent years show a rebound in profitability in fiscal 2023 and a slight revenue decline in fiscal 2024, with pressure on margins. The stock’s view: Intel shares look stretched relative to current cyclical fundamentals, but the turnaround and foundry ambitions remain key catalysts."}
